sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN res.time IS NOT NULL THEN res.driverId END) / NULLIF(COUNT(res.driverId), 0) AS completion_percentage FROM results AS res JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese' AND r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009;
